text: Driver correction before submitting build-artifacts 0: generation-metadata.tex lacked contribution lines for author-study iterations 1-2 and derive-homily iteration 1, which produced the accepted files (sibling leaves 66 and 67 record every revising iteration; guidance/editorial.md treats the declarations as the complete record).
